name: study-tracker
description: Lets Claude read your course files and help you study in the Study Tracker app on this Mac. Works on the free Claude plan.
long_description: Study Tracker keeps your courses, files, deadlines and flashcards on your Mac. This extension gives Claude restricted access: it can read your schedule and course files, lay out each course as a path of topics, write its notebook guide and lessons, sort files, label practice problems, and save notes and proposed deadlines back into the app. It cannot delete anything, and deadlines or study blocks it suggests wait for your confirmation. Nothing leaves your Mac except what you share in the conversation.
